summary: The bill directs the Secretary of Commerce to run a two-year pilot program that enters cooperative agreements with pet-food, animal-feed, and aquaculture-feed manufacturers to buy blue catfish caught by watermen in the Chesapeake Bay Watershed at a minimum price per pound set by the Secretary, with certifications, limited transport reimbursements, abundance estimates, and a required report to Congress.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes a new federal pilot program under NOAA that requires the Secretary to enter into cooperative agreements and award amounts to covered entities for purchasing blue catfish. This creates new federal expenditures for a multi-year initiative (including data collection, reporting, and program administration), directly expanding government spending.
The bill contains no provisions related to taxes, tax rates, credits, or revenue collection.
The bill contains no provisions related to healthcare delivery, insurance, public health programs, or medical services.
The bill contains no provisions related to firearms, regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The bill contains no provisions related to immigration, visas, border security, or immigrant protections.
The bill contains no provisions related to reproductive rights or abortion access.
The bill contains no provisions related to military, defense, or national security spending.

The bill creates a pilot program explicitly intended to mitigate the population of invasive blue catfish in the Chesapeake Bay Watershed, including requirements to estimate abundance, assess environmental effects on other species, and develop policy recommendations for controlling invasive aquatic species. This constitutes a targeted environmental protection and invasive-species mitigation effort.
The bill contains no provisions related to welfare programs, food assistance, or social safety-net benefits.
The bill contains no provisions related to schools, education funding, or school choice.
The bill contains no provisions related to controlled substances, decriminalization, or drug enforcement.
The bill contains no provisions related to sentencing, policing, or criminal justice reform.
The bill contains no provisions related to tariffs, trade agreements, or import/export policy.
While the bill authorizes new spending, it does not address debt reduction, deficit targets, or fiscal policy mechanisms; any debt implications are indirect and secondary.
The bill contains no provisions related to LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
The bill contains no provisions related to foreign assistance or international aid.
The bill contains no provisions related to voting access, election administration, or voter ID.
The bill contains no provisions related to technology regulation, data privacy, or digital oversight.
The bill supports watermen through a purchase program but does not address union rights, collective bargaining, or labor protections.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious exemptions or anti-discrimination law.
